measurement: Continuous finite door-interior to threshold-centre segment, each point in floor XZ. The whole-mesh measurement projects every loaded triangle; mesh witness XZ is a nearest projected point. Mesh distance to a filled projected face is zero for an intersection; this zero is not a penetration-depth estimate. The circular estimate circumscribes the measured 32-sided ground patch. The production slab check expands the room-local AABB by a square and treats contact as blocked. Connectivity refers to the static same-floor grid.

rules.scope: C1/C2 static conservative placement and same-floor portal connectivity
